description: This file implements a multiple dispatch system with classes and functions for managing type-based method dispatching, including handling variadic signatures, ambiguity warnings, and deprecated interfaces.

classes.name: MDNotImplementedError
classes.description: Custom error indicating a method is not implemented for multiple dispatch.

classes.name: Dispatcher
classes.description: Class managing method registration and dispatch based on argument types, supporting variadic signatures and ambiguity warnings.

classes.name: MethodDispatcher
classes.description: Subclass of Dispatcher for dispatching methods on class instances, supporting method binding.

methods.name: ambiguity_warn
methods.description: Issues a warning when ambiguous signatures are detected in dispatch.

methods.name: restart_ordering
methods.description: Deprecated function to resume ordering, with optional ambiguity warning callback.

methods.name: variadic_signature_matches_iter
methods.description: Generator checking if a set of types matches a variadic signature.

methods.name: variadic_signature_matches
methods.description: Checks if types match a variadic signature.

methods.name: source
methods.description: Returns the source code of a function as a string.

methods.name: str_signature
methods.description: Creates a string representation of a type signature.

methods.name: warning_text
methods.description: Generates warning text for ambiguous signatures.
